channel.title: Animesh Singh
channel.description: Selected engineering projects: shipped products and public code.

item.title: Connekt
item.description: An offline-first, transport-agnostic P2P messaging engine in Rust that bridges BLE, Wi-Fi Direct, and cloud relay into one mesh, with a Flutter client over FFI.

item.title: ClipHoard
item.description: Cross-platform clipboard sync between macOS and Android over a lightweight WebSocket relay: copy on one device, paste on the other in seconds.

item.title: Cadenza
item.description: An interactive music theory companion: fretboard, circle of fifths, ear training, and a keyboard-driven rhythm game for learning real songs, in light and dark themes.

item.title: RTMP
item.description: A synchronized movie-watching platform: upload a film, share a link, and everyone in the room stays in lockstep on play, pause, and seek, with chat and no account required to join.
